text: Oc-serv Southern Crests are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black, magenta-eyed Oc-servs, or for 98 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Gravity Res Up and SpecUp.GRAV-RES augments.

Oc-serv Hands are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Oc-servs. They are components in all Critical Chance Up and CriticalUp augments. Three are required for Lending a Hand.
O.X. Units are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black Galdrs.

Nopon Despair is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a sad Nopon, Muimui, who is under attack by a pack of indigens and needs help during Muimui's Meltdown. It is obtained as a reward for completing this Normal Mission.
Oc-serv A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a yellow oc-serv variant. It can be obtained from Oc-serv, the Ancient in Sylvalum.
Oc-serv B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a gray oc-serv variant. It can be obtained from Na-mulk, the Rebellious in Cauldros.
Oc-serv C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a brass oc-serv variant. It can be obtained from Si-el, the Vacuous in Noctilum.
Oc-serv D is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black oc-serv variant. It can be obtained from Ro-darm, the Demon Claw in Oblivia.

Nopon Tower VS Prone is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts three Nopon standing on top of each other as well as a Prone. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission The Trading Floor.

Nursery Bed Boost is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.6, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting six Mizaria Celerys. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Odd Symbiosis is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.12, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting ten Murras. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Nopopon is a NPC in and . He can be found at Whale's Nostril in Noctilum, then south of the BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles at late night. He is one of four divine Nopon spirits alongside Napopon, Nipopon and Nupopon, and is fought as Nopopon Incarnate.

Nupopon is a NPC in . He can be found at Quay Hollows in Sylvalum during The Divine Nopopon, and is fought as Nupopon Incarnate. He is one of four Nopon spirits alongside Nipopon, Napopon and Nopopon.

The Nopon Gemstone is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received from the Nopopon during The Divine Nopopon, to be returned to him after it has been blessed by the Napopon, Nipopon, and Nupopon.
Nullify Physical Reflect is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that gives a chance to bypass reflection of physical-attribute attacks. The Skell equivalent is Reflect.NEG-PHYS.
Nullify Beam Reflect is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that gives a chance to bypass reflection of beam-attribute attacks. The Skell equivalent is Reflect.NEG-BEAM.
Nullify Ether Reflect is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that gives a chance to bypass reflection of ether-attribute attacks. The Skell equivalent is Reflect.NEG-ETHER.
Nullify Thermal Reflect is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that gives a chance to bypass reflection of thermal-attribute attacks. The Skell equivalent is Reflect.NEG-THERM.
Nullify Electric Reflect is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that gives a chance to bypass reflection of electric-attribute attacks. The Skell equivalent is Reflect.NEG-ELEC.
Nullify Gravity Reflect is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that gives a chance to bypass reflection of gravity-attribute attacks. The Skell equivalent is Reflect.NEG-GRAV.
Opening Art Damage Up is a ground weapon art mod augment in and . It boosts damage from the first Art used in a battle by 5% to 100%. The Skell equivalent is Draw.OPENING-DMG.
Nutritious Microbes are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained solely from Largo Selua in the Bionis' Interior.
Nopox Hobby Store (Japanese: , Hobī Toinopokkusu) is a shop in . It is run by Amumu and can be found in the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild. It is specialized in Board Games.

The Olethro Ruins (Japanese: , Karamu no Iseki) is a level in . They are located at the top of the Great Stairway of Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya, on the Urayan Titan's back. Prior to the Aegis War, Mythra was awakened here. After Chapter 3, a portal will appear here that grants access to the Land of Challenge. This will only become available if the Expansion Pass has been purchased and the Nopon Summons has been received.

The Omega Fetter is an object in . It is a royal artifact guarded by the royal family of the Kingdom of Tantal, and is located at Genbu Crown. It takes the appearance of a glowing blue cube, normally encased in a golden metal sphere.

The Noponya Shrine (Japanese: , Poponoe Shidō) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Goldmouth Rooftop at the Argentum Trade Guild. It can be accessed by using the Ancient Nopon Key obtained during the quest The Nopon Murals.

Obra Street (Japanese: , Ōbera-dōri) is a location in . It is located in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. The street starts at the Torigoth Market, then heads behind the inn before ending in front of the Galad Residential Zone. There are no enemies here except during story and quest events.
The Old Ghostwood Road (Japanese: , Reiju no Furumichi) is a landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Gormott Province and leads from the Trailblazers' Bridge uphill to Masrah Spring.
Olno's Mess Hall (Japanese: , Oruno Shokudō) is a location in . It is a room aboard the Titan Battleship, docked in the Gormott Province, between the Mid-ship Walkway Door and the Living Quarters.
The Old Industrial District (Japanese: , Kyūseisan-ku - Okujōkuchi) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Nopon Pioneers' Spring (Japanese: , Nopon Kaitakusha no Hitō) is a Secret Area in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. It can be reached from the Ruined Laborers' Bridge, or from the Old Industrial District by going near the top of the big stairwell then exiting at the top towards the cliff face. The level 3 "Earth Mastery" and level 2 "Leaping" Field Skills are required to reach this Landmark. It must be visited to unlock Perceval's level 2 "Assassination" Field Skill.
The Office Corridor (Japanese: , Jimushitsu-mae Tsūro) is a Location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Old Pipe Junction Corridor (Japanese: , Kyūhaikan-shitsu Renrakutsūro) is a Location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. From this place can be reached the Ruined Laborers' Bridge, the Office Corridor after obtaining the Old Town Gate Key, and the Junction Control Room after obtaining the Control Room Key.
The Old Factory Warehouse (Japanese: , Haikōjō Kamotsu Sōko) is a Location in . It is located in the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Old Valantia (Japanese: , Rōju Vurirante) is a Location in . It is a large Saffronia located in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.

The Old Pilgrim's Road (Japanese: , Kyū Junrei Kaidō) is a Location in . It is located in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya. It is a staircase between the Sevind Palace Plaza and the Ruins of Fountain Park. In , the Old Pilgrim's Road is shown to have collapsed.
The Old Quarry (Japanese: , Saisekijō-ato) is a location in . It is located in the Stomach of Uraya, north-west of the Stone Gate Ruins. There is a Treasure Trove here.

Olethro Playhouse (Japanese: , Karamu Gekijō) is a Landmark in . It is part of the Olethro Ruins in the Kingdom of Uraya. After the quest Farewell, Good Friend is completed in Chapter 10, high-level enemies such as Beast-Hunter William will appear throughout the place. After Chapter 3, a portal will appear here that grants access to the Unbroken Pillar in the Land of Challenge. This will only become available if the Expansion Pass has been purchased and the Nopon Summons has been received. The Heart-to-Heart "The Literary Life" can be viewed here.

The Old Temple (Japanese: , Furuboketa Kyōkai) is a landmark in . It is located on the Upper Level of the First Low Orbit Station, in Elysium. A staircase inside leads down to the Architect's Room. There is a Treasure Trove on the right-hand side from the door, and one on the left side of the building's exterior. The Old Temple can be seen in the distance in Dreamworld Elysium. There are no enemies here.

The Old Factory (Japanese: , Haikōjō) is a level in . It is located in the Empire of Mor Ardain. During Chapter 4, the vast majority of enemies in the factory are Tirkin. The Tirkin disappear in chapter 5, but after the party enters the First Low Orbit Station, they are replaced by level 94-99 Drivers, and the level 120 Superboss Chickenheart Dagmara appears in the Industrial Zone, Upper Duct. Between these chapters there are no enemies present.

Novl Ories (Japanese: , Nēva Oriesu) are enemies in . They are members of the Ories family, and can be found at level 36-41 around the Argan Iceblooms in the east of the Kingdom of Tantal, except during Cloud Sea Mist. Four must be defeated to unlock Mythra's level 3 Ray of Punishment.

The Nuclear Dump Facility (Japanese: , Hōshasei Haikibutsu Shorishitsu) is a location in . It is a room located on the Lower Level of the World Tree, between Lv. 2, Mizar: Central Deck and the Control Room. The water in the facility must be drained by accessing a button in the Control Room, causing the Waste Store to fill with water and a Treasure Trove and Collection Point to become accessible. It also must be drained to access an elevator to the Sky Bridge.
Nopon Chess Sets are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased at the Nopox Hobby Store in the Argentum Trade Guild.
The Nopox Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from the Nopox Hobby Store in the Argentum Trade Guild after completing the Merc Missions Cooking Display and First Class Freshness!.
Odifa Gelée Tarts are Dessert Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Salter Sweets in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Nopopo Yard are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Hobby Knick-Knacks in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. They are one of Poppibuster's favorite Pouch items.
Odifa Punches are Dessert Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Placks Patisserie in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Noponic Nails are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Praximo Cosmetics in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Ollat is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. Ollat can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain's Alba Cavanich. Ollat runs a shop called Adelno Music specialized in Instruments.

Nullify Reaction is a Blade Art in . It grants the Driver a buff that nullifies the next reaction (Break, Topple, Launch, Smash, Knockback or Blowdown) that is inflicted on them. It does not help the Driver recover from the current reaction afflicting them. This effect lasts until a reaction is nullified or 15 seconds pass. A reaction that is nullified displays "No effect" next to its tag. This effect persists across Blade Switches. The AC Reaction Nullify Arts Card grants Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ access to this Blade Art, with cooldown that varies with equipment rank. The duration of the buff can be extended up to 22.5s with the effects of the Helping Hand Aux Core or Skill RAM.
Nose Gogols (Japanese: , Nōsu Gogōru) are enemies in . They are members of the Gogol family and can be found at level 11-17 at Nocclia Woods in the Gormott Province.

Nopopomouli are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be obtained in batches of 3 by doing the repeatable Merc Mission Manufacture Help given by Nomon at Kloom Farm in the Gormott Province. Five must be collected to unlock Fiora's level 2 "Nopon Wisdom" Field Skill.

Not Quite Comfortable Yet is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Cobalt Cliffs in the Kingdom of Uraya, and is available after resting at Harghalgh Inn in Garfont Village. Viewing this Heart-to-Heart unlocks Ursula's Level 1 "Harmony" Field Skill.

One Last You is the ending theme of . It was composed by Yasunori Mitsuda along with Mariam Abounnasr, who was credited specifically for the String arrangement. Although Tetsuya Takahashi came up with the original lyrics, the English translation was provided by LYSSA and Castro Satoshi. Jen Bird, a singer from the United Kingdom, lent her voice for the song. One Last You is also featured as an available karaoke song in Karaoke JOYSOUND for Nintendo Switch.
The Nopon Workers' Quarters (Japanese: , Nopon Sagyōin Kyojūku) is a Location in . It is located in the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Noponchos are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Future Crafts in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Odifas are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Cafe Lutino in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Nuruba Upas (Japanese: , Niruba Ūpā) are enemies in . They are members of the Upa family, and can be found at level 20-23 in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya, particularly at Eight-Rock Skip, Farlaine Wells or Tardy Gate. Two of them must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 2 Alae Custodiae Battle Skill.
Norgam Ignas (Japanese: , Runogā Igūna) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 50-54 at the Bastion of Varrac on the Central Plain of Temperantia.
Odolera Ropls (Japanese: , Odorura Ryibura) are enemies in . They are members of the Ropl family, and can be found at level 47-49 at the Malignant Gorge on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Obri Aligos (Japanese: , Oburi Diburo) are enemies in . They are members of the Aligo family, and can be found at level 80-82 at the Memorial Ruins in the Head of the Kingdom of Tantal, or at level 82-84 at the Little Banerro Ruins and Twin Pillars on the Upper Level and the Genbu Drifts on the Lower Level. They only appear during Cloud Sea Mist.
Nossi Lysaats (Japanese: , Nazūru Shīsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lysaat family, and can be found at level 43-45 at Bone Road on the Upper Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys.
Nopon Dolls (Japanese: , Nopon Ningyō) are accessories in and . They allow the wearer to keep 50% of their current Aggro after they get incapacitated.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Omega Drives (Japanese: , Omega Doraibu) are accessories in and . They slightly increase the Party Gauge every time the wearer inflicts a Critical Hit.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Nopon Masks (Japanese: , Nopon no Kamen) are accessories in and . They increase the Aggro of the wearer passively by a small amount every second. By default, Tora joins the team with one of these equipped. The Metal Nopon Mask, Gold Nopon Mask, and Platinum Nopon Mask accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.
The Nopon Doubloons are Key Items in . There are eleven in total scattered all throughout Alrest. They are required for Nopon Doubloons Ahoy.
Ontos (Japanese: , Ousia) is one of three units of the Trinity Processor in the .
Ogre Slam (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Ether Cannon.

Noughtili are Fish collectibles in . They can be found on the World Tree, in particular from the three Collection Points located across the water in the Waste Store next to the Mizar, Elevator #8 landmark. In the , Noughtili can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Numbing Clownfishes are Fish collectibles in . They can be found on the World Tree. In the , Numbing Clownfishes can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Normal Cylinders are cylinders in . They are the lowest-tier cylinders in the game.

Nyol Flamiis (Japanese: , Nyōru Furamī) are enemies in . They are members of the Flamii family and can be found at level 31-35 on Baldotas Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago. Five must be defeated in order to unlock Mythra's level 2 Photon Edge, and Wulfric's level 3 Termination Blast.

Opal Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be dropped by a wide variety of enemies and rewarded for completing Bana's Secret Treasure in and Great Tornan Cook-Off in . Opal Chips share their appearance with Garnet Chips, Aquamarine Chips, and Zircon Chips. __TOC__

Olphen Jagrons (Japanese: , Orufen Jagāru) are enemies in . They are members of the Jagron family, and can be found at level 31-35 on Daram Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago during the day. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Nim's level 3 "Wild Familiars".
Nula Scouts (Japanese: , Nyūra Sukauto) are enemies in . They are Sovereigns, and can be found at level 55-61 at the Mizar, Elevator #8 in the World Tree.

Noral Volffs (Japanese: , Nora Vorufu) are three quest-exclusive enemies found in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 42 in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal during the quest Flames of Justice.

The Offended Gogol (Japanese: , Fundo no Gogōru) is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a Gogol, and the mother of the Indignant Gogol and Enraged Gogol. It is fought on the path to the Sacred Ice Caverns in the Kingdom of Tantal during Tender-Hearted Beast.

The Ominous Ardun (Japanese: , Zenchō no Arudon) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Ardun family, and can be found at level 80 at the Kloom Farm in the Gormott Province, after supplying Pekka with a certain amount of food for his Ardun. This enemy will not respawn. It is recommended to not defeat the enemy, and to complete Ardun Rearing instead, to gain access to a Unique Monster Feeding the Ardun during the quest Ardun Rearing will change it to: * Infant Ardun (Lv 1) * Young Ardun (Lv 20) * Youthful Ardun (Lv 40) * Adult Ardun (Lv 60) * Ominous Ardun (Lv 80) * Relentless Arduran (Lv 99)
The Note Fragment is a Key Item in . It is found in the Acid Gullet of the Kingdom of Uraya. Finding it triggers the quest Mysterious Note.
Nutch Lexos (Japanese: , Nachūru Rekusosu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lexos family, and can be found at level 55-59 at the 7th Perimeter Skyport on the World Tree after Salvaging.
Nowaak Crustips (Japanese: , Nowāku Shuribu) are enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family, and can be found at level 36-40 after Salvaging at Goetuis Wharf #1 in the Indoline Praetorium.
Nopon Doubloons Ahoy is a quest in . It can be received from Nunui at Goldmouth Viewpoint in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Nunui is a Nopon in . He can be found in the Argentum Trade Guild, where he gives the quest Nopon Doubloons Ahoy. He keenly interested in collecting all Nopon Doubloons hidden around Alrest.
One Step Ahead is a quest in . It can be received from Capher on a ledge near the bottom of Varnax's Plunge in the Gormott Province.

Nopopon's Journal is a Key Item in . It is obtained after exploring the coordinates in the vicinity of Old Valantia in Garfont Village during the quest Uncover the Truth. It provides information on the origin of the modern Nopon dialect.

On the Son's Trail! (Japanese: , Musuko no Tegakari wo Oe!) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the quest Fame and Family. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Beguiling Charms", "Focus" and "Keen Eye" Field Skills. It can be used to obtain information on the whereabouts of Solala. However, it is not required to complete the quest, as the information can also be bought from Mumufa for 4,000 G.

The Nopon Thank-You Note is a Key Item in . It is rewarded by the owner of 12 Brothersisterpon, Motata, in the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild after finding all 11 Brothersisterpon scattered across Alrest.

The Old Town Gate Key is a Key Item in . It is obtained in the Old Industrial District in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It unlocks the door connecting the Office Corridor to the Old Pipe Junction Corridor.

Olivio is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found at the Commercial District in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. He is fishing out on the docks southeast of the Gate. Giving him a Coral Nopon Chess Set is an option for one of Perun's Small Good Deeds.

The Noponcho Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Nopon Cooking. It enables the player to purchase Noponchos from the Future Crafts shop in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

The Odifa Punch Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Weathered Ship. It enables the purchase of Odifa Punch from the Placks Patisserie shop at Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Obstinate Pursuit is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago after completing the mission Can't Escape. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Electric Mastery", "Focus" and "Clairvoyant Eye" Field Skills. Completing this mission unlocks the Merc Mission Chase Is On.
Nubnub is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found at the Cliffs of Morytha's Inlet. He runs the shop Bamboo Sword Smithy.

The Odur Igna (Japanese: , Ōdā Igūna) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Igna family and can be found at level 21 in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya during Gotta Start Somewhere! alongside the Rood Ignas.

Open Your Eyes is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on Silvergleam Terrace within Theoscaldia Palace in the Kingdom of Tantal. It features a conversation between Mòrag and Zeke on the nature of loyalty and patriotism. The two options to select are "Without a doubt." and "Would you not?", the former one ending with Zeke and Mòrag agreeing.
The Note on Lance is a Key Item in . It is needed to complete the quest Blade-Sharp Memory. It obtained at Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
The Note on Lance 2 is a Key Item in . It is obtained at Garagorm's Arch in Torigoth during the quest Blade-Sharp Memory.
Olioli is an NPC in . Olioli is a Nopon who can be found in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. Olioli runs a shop called Dolphin Salvagers.

Opened Fan (Japanese: , Supureddofan, Lit. "Spread Fan") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Infinity Fans. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Wide Slash.
Occadia is an NPC in . She is a Leftherian who can be found by the garden near Corinne's House in the Leftherian Archipelago. She offers the Merc Mission Cloud Sea Noises.

Nopon of Good Tastes is a DLC Quest in . It is one of five quests released as downloadable content, the New Quests Pack 2 of the Expansion Pass. After Poppi has joined the party and the unlock item collected from the "Expansion Pass" menu, the quest can be received from Bipopo in the Galad Residential Zone in Gormott Province.
Number of Arts is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at the Market of Torigoth in the Gormott Province.

Noted Ardainian Doctor is an Info Item in . It is received by completing the merc mission Skillful Doctor or purchased from the Mor Ardain Informant for 10,000 G, and is necessary for the quest A Secret Cure.
The Note on Lance 3 is a Key Item in . It is obtained in the Nharil Central Plaza in Alba Cavanich during the quest Blade-Sharp Memory.
The Nopon Trade Guild ID is a Key Item in . It is obtained on Daram Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago during the quest Birds of a Feather.
Omulette is an NPC in . She is a Tirkin who can be found at Tirkinlandia in the Kingdom of Tantal during the quest Birds of a Feather.

Obsi Marrins (Japanese: , Oburisu Mārin) are enemies in . They are members of the Marrin family, and can be found at level 42-46 on Godsford Isle or the Isle of Urchon in the Leftherian Archipelago after salvaging.
Nunana is an NPC in . She can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys, near Wonder Spring Plaza Ruins. Nunana is one of the Twelve Brothersisterpon.
The Nopon Archsage (Japanese: , Nopon daisen'nin) is a recurring character in the .

Noponstone Exchange (Japanese: , Nopon Kurisutaru Kōkan) is a DLC Shop in . It is run by the Archsage's Orderly and can be found in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.
Noponstones (Japanese: , Nopon Kurisutaru) are items in the .
The Nopon Summons are a DLC Key Item in . They can be obtained after installing the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. They grant access to Challenge Battle Mode.
Nugby is a Gormotti in . He can be found on Kloom Farm in Torigoth, standing in front of the field under Nomon's.
The Nopon Invitation is a DLC Key Item in . It can be collected from the New Difficulty Levels pack released as part of the 1.5.1 update.

Novice Cylinder-Crafter is a DLC Shop in . It is run by Seesaw and can be found at Torika Alley in the Kingdom of Uraya, during and after completing the DLC Quest Sunken Boosters available as downloadable content, the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass.

Ohlala is a Nopon NPC in . She is the daughter of Tekuteku, and is found at Smùide Hot Spring in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC quest Hot Spring Bonanza, which is part of the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass.

Obsidian Dromarch (Japanese: ) is a DLC Aux Core in . It decreases the Aggro generated by Arts and Specials by 15%. It also changes Dromarch's appearance when he equips the core, granting him a dark color scheme. It is unlocked after the Nopon Invitation is collected from the Helpful New Features released as part of the version 1.5.1 update and can be purchased at the Noponstone Exchange for 300 Noponstones in the Land of Challenge. The Savage Dromarch DLC Aux Core has an equivalent effect, which is functionally identical to the Arts Stealth V Aux Core.

Obligatory Leave Mòrag (Japanese: , Shikatanaku Mizugi no Merefu) is a DLC Accessory in . It can be purchased at the DLC shop Noponstone Exchange for 50 Flawless Noponstones in the Land of Challenge obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. When equipped by Mòrag, it changes her outward appearance to a black one-piece swimsuit with a translucent middle section.

The Nopon Summons, Pt. 2 are a DLC Key Item in . They can be obtained from the Expansion Pass after updating to Version 1.5.2. They unlock Otherworldly Fighter and Poisoned Paradise in Challenge Battle Mode.

The Nopon Invitation, Pt. 2 is a DLC Key Item in . It can be obtained from the Expansion Pass on Version 1.5.2 or later. It unlocks the Noponstone Exchange run by the Orderly's Orderly and the Pouch Item Emporium, as well as unlock new items in the Noponstone Exchange run by the Archsage's Orderly.

Onyx is an NPC in . He is a squad leader in the Tornan military who can be found at the Viridian Gate in Auresco of the Kingdom of Torna. He directly oversees Chalcedony and Carnelian, and his Community is gained alongside Carnelian's upon completion of Manning the Gates.
Nuts About Bugs is a quest in . It can be received from Marcus in the Fabri Industry Ward in Auresco the capital of the Kingdom of Torna.

Omnom is an NPC in . She is a Nopon gourmet who can be found at the Formide Shopping Ward in Auresco of the Kingdom of Torna. Upon being well-fed, Omnom grows far beyond her initial size, much like Dabidabi. Her Community is gained upon completion of this quest.

Olnard's Trail (Japanese: , Orunato Yamamichi) is a location in . It is a path between Lett Bridge and Hyber Village in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna. There are several Collection Points, an ether miasma and a Campsite here.

The Nopon Halfsage is an NPC in . He is a very small Nopon avatar of greed who can be found in the Cavern of the Seal in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna. He functions as a shop, and can be sold to or bought from; he sells the locations of the four Golden Monsters in order to raise funds to reconstruct the seals preventing entry to his cavern. Unlike most Nopon, the Halfsage speaks in first person. The Halfsage offers no quests, but his Community is gained upon talking to him after defeating all four Golden Monsters.

The Nox Promontory (Japanese: , Nokkusu Unkai Misaki) is a location in . It is located in the far western area Gormott, across the Duelists' Bridge. It is an outcropping that provides a view of Gormott's back legs, tail, and the Cloud Sea. There are no enemies here. A book of glassworking has been buried here, and must be unearthed during Passing the Torch.
Norra is an NPC in . She is an Ardainian who can be found at Rigitte Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Oone Ekidnos (Japanese: , Ūno Ekidona) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Ekidno family and can be found at level 43 - 45 at Lake Wynn and the Verdant Fairylands in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. Two must be defeated to unlock Aegaeon's level 5 Hundred-Year Wave Blade Special.

Obibi is an NPC in . She is a Nopon fashion designer who can be found at the Formide Shopping Ward in Auresco of the Kingdom of Torna. Dekudeku teams up with her after takng an interest in her business. She gives the quest Bolstering Sales, and her Community is gained alongside Dekudeku's upon its completion.

Ofa is an NPC in . She is an old Tornan who can be found at the Median Gate in the Kingdom of Torna. She used to run a shop in Formide Shopping Ward, where she would interact with Rooroo and his siblings, but has retired to let her granddaughter, Yrissa, run the shop. She gives the quest Forest Trail Antics, and her Community is gained alongside Yrissa's upon its completion.
Ogre Smash (Japanese: , Ōgasurasshu, Lit. "Ogre Slash") is one of Addam's Vanguard Arts in .
Ntoto is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Nopon and can be found in Dopang Caravan near the Cleansing Spring in Sylvalum during the day after Castle in the Sky is completed.

The Old Expedition HQ (Japanese: , Chōsadan Chūton Atochi) is a landmark in . It is located on the Bionis' Shoulder, north-west of Gamaro Hollow, which is the only place it can be reached from as it is too far down to fall to. A Ponspector, Nonona, can be found here before he joins the party via completing Nonona's Calling. There are no enemies here, but there is a fire ether deposit.

The Old King's Testament (Japanese: , Hōmurareta Rekiōhi no Ma) is a landmark in . It is a square of Giant's ruins located on the Bionis' Shoulder, northeast of Thulles Way and northwest of Gran Dell Ramparts. Climbing the inner walls is the only way to reach Agni's Skygarden Ruins. There is a wind ether deposit here.
Oh, Brother! is a Time Attack challenge in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage. The challenge battle is located at Eryth Sea, it is unlocked after completing the High Entia Tomb.

Officer's Hats are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition. They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge He of the Metal Face. They can only be worn by Sharla.
Officer's Tops are light torso armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge He of the Metal Face. They can only be worn by Sharla.
Officer's Bangles are light arms armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge He of the Metal Face. They can only be worn by Sharla.
Officer's Skirts are light legs armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge He of the Metal Face. They can only be worn by Sharla.
Officer's Pumps are light feet armour in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge He of the Metal Face. They can only be worn by Sharla.

Nullify Heal is a status effect in and . It is a party debuff that temporarily reduces all healing effects targeting the Driver to zero, preventing Hit Point restoration. When the debuff activates, the Driver becomes surrounded by ice particles, circling the character with a shape similar to thorns. It lasts for 15 seconds. In , Blades can also be inflicted with Nullify Heal. The status effect will always be kept on the vanguard, even after performing a Vanguard Switch, however the red recoverable HP restoring effect of the switch can bypass the heal block.
Nostalgic Amulets are heavy arms armour in . They can only be worn by Nene. They can be obtained from Pororo by giving her five of her Favourites.
Nostalgic Anklets are heavy feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Nene. They can be obtained from Pororo by giving her ten of her Favourites.
Nostalgic Ribbons are heavy head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Nene. They can be obtained from Pororo by giving her one of her Favourites.
Nostalgic Rucksacks are heavy legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Nene. They can be obtained from Pororo by giving her ten of her Favourites.
Nostalgic Plates are heavy torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Nene. They can be obtained from Pororo by giving her five of her Favourites.
Noponic Axion (Japanese: , Noponikku akushion) is Poppi QTπ's Level II Blade Special in .
Noponic Storm (Japanese: , Noponikku sutōmu) is Poppi α's Level II Blade Special in .
Open Wide! (Japanese: , Itadakimasu ppo) is Boreas's Level I Blade Special in .
Ogre (Japanese: , Hasai-shi, Crusher) is an Agnian Attacker class in .

Obliterator Centaurio (Japanese: , Senmetsugata Sentorio) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Gyrinus type Agnian Levnis and can be found at level 91 at the Levnis Workyard in the Agnus Castle Barbican. The Psychowave Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

The Old Cliffside Way (Japanese: , Dangai no Kodō) is an Area in , located in the Pentelas Region. It is a pathway through a structure from the Land of Morytha. It serves as the entrance into Maktha Wildwood from Great Cotte Falls.
Normal Monsters are enemies in . They are usually members of a species, reflected in the second part of their names (for example, Heavy Brog are members of the Brog family).
The Old Way Camp (Japanese: , Kodō no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located at the Old Cliffside Way in the Pentelas Region. The Old Way Caravan is located here.
The Old Kana Battlefield (Japanese: , Kāna no Kosenjō) is a Landmark in . It is located on Rae-Bel Tableland in the Fornis Region. It is the ruins of Colony 18.

The Old Road of Rebirth (Japanese: , Rin'ne no Kodō) is a Landmark in , located outside the Agnus Castle Barbican in the Cadensia Region. It leads to Captocorn Peak. The head of the Bionis can be seen from here, which connects to the Aetia Region via one of Gormott's horns.
Odd Triangular Shards are Key Items in . After Uniting the Seven Nopon is completed, the shards turn into Trigonal Origin Shards.
Odd Square Shards are Key Items in . After Uniting the Seven Nopon is completed, the shards turn into Square Origin Shards.
Odd Six-Angled Shards are Key Items in . After Uniting the Seven Nopon is completed, the shards turn into Hexagonal Orig. Shards.
Odd Round Shards are Key Items in . After Uniting the Seven Nopon is completed, the shards turn into Round Origin Shards.
Odd Ringlike Shards are Key Items in . After Uniting the Seven Nopon is completed, the shards turn into Toroidal Origin Shards.
Odd Pointy Shards are Key Items in . After Uniting the Seven Nopon is completed, the shards turn into Rhomboid Orig. Shards.
Odd Oblong Shards are Key Items in . After Uniting the Seven Nopon is completed, the shards turn into Rectangular Ori. Shards.
The North Sector Passage (Japanese: , Kitakukan Renrakutsūro) is a Location in , located in the Origin Interior.
The North Shell Passage (Japanese: , Hokumen Gaikaku Tsūro) is a Location in , located in the Origin Interior.

Nopon Register is a Standard Quest in . The Nopon Merchant Shillshill tasks the party with 19 collecting Nopon Pebbles of the red, blue, and yellow varieties from Nopon Caravans across Aionios. Shillshill provides the party with 1 Yellow Nopon Pebble upon starting the quest.
Oil Oyster Fossils are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced from the Desert Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Oil Lentils are Seed Collectibles in and . They can be found in the Pentelas Region in . They can also be purchased from the Colony Tau Caravan, or produced from the Cascade Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They can be found on The Ragmos Desolation in . In , they can also be purchased from the Col. 9 Supply Office (New).

Obsidian Berries are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region and can also be produced by the Fabricator at the Cascade Ferronis Hulk or at the Clifftop Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Onogoro Piranhax are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Piranhax family, and can be found at level 27-28 at Great Cotte Falls.
Ocular Sensors are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Nova Drives are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Origin. They can also be produced from the Battlescar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator after reaching Origin for the first time.
Obscurians are items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced from the Desert Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Obsidian Kananus Manes are items in . They are dropped from Eruno Kananuses.
Olkort Ellooks are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ellook family, and can be found at level 53-54 in Farlaine Underpass in Erythia Sea.

Olivia-Anne is an NPC in . She was part of Lenny's squad alongside Jango and Marlon before being killed by monsters in Yzana Plains. Noah sends her and her fallen comrades off during the quest Farewell Melody. __NOTOC__

The Nopon Caravans is a Colony in . It consists of numerous Nopon merchants located throughout Aionios that are unaffiliated with Keves and Agnus. They appear at most Rest Spots and Colonies to sell items and equipment.
The O'Virbus Commissary is a shop in . It is run by a Fort O'Virbus Soldier and can be found in Fort O'Virbus on the Syra Hovering Reefs after completing Side Story: Noah.

O'Virbus Caravan is a shop in . It is run by the O'Virbus Traderpon in Fort O'Virbus on the Syra Hovering Reefs upon reaching Affinity Level 2 with Keves Castle. It sells Aetia Region and Cadensia Region Collectibles.
The Old Way Caravan is a shop in . It is run by a Traderpon and can be found at the Old Way Camp at the Old Cliffside Way.
Nopon Straps are Accessories in and . They can be bought at the Nopon Coin X-change for 80 Silver Nopon Coins. One can be received from the first wave of the Expansion Pass.
Onigiri is a Key Item in . It is a food popular throughout Agnian colonies. Sena makes some for Segiri during Inhumanity.

One-Cup Liquid Grubs are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region, or via the Fabricator at Perimeter Outlet in the Cadensia Region after the recolonization of Colony 0 and the first renovation step.
Olkort Anloods (Japanese: , Urukōto Haindo) are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Anlood family, and can be found at level 57-58 on Captocorn Peak.
Nutritious Block Bars are Meal items in . They can be purchased from the Central Cell Canteen.
Noponic Champion (Japanese: , Noponikkubureibu) is a DLC Agnian Defender class in .

Null Slash (Japanese: , Rimūbusurasshu) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Flash Fencer class. When performed, the user dashes forward and does a spreading slash with the sabers while hopping backwards.

Nopon Eater is a DLC Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Vollgull family, and is fought three times during The Hope of Noponkind, first at level 48 on the Urayan Trail, and then twice in succession at Anu Shoals in Erythia Sea, first at level 49 and then again at level 50.

On Gramps's Back is an Area and Landmark in . It is located on Azurda's back and is where Rex lives and does his Salvaging work. It is the first location visited in the game, but can only be visited as its own area during the fight against the King Crustip. Afterwards, Azurda swims to the Argentum Trade Guild, where he can be climbed on top of during Chapter 1 while he waits for Rex to return, but is no longer considered to be a Landmark.

Noponic Gold is a DLC Key Item in . It can be bought from the Prize X-change Red for 3000 red Noponstone or from the Prize X-change Blue for 600 blue Noponstone. It is used to enhance accessories at rest spots.
The Open-Air Dining Space (Japanese: , Aozora Shokudō) is a location in . It is located in the Central Plaza of Colony 9 in Yesterdale. It is built during Georgie's Ask.

Nullify Most Attacks is a Status Effect in . It causes most attacks to miss the affected character. Alpha is able to gain this buff when using the Arts Monado Speed and Vision Mode. Fusion Arts are an exception to this.
The Old Legre-Bhaja Battlefront (Japanese: , Regurebāja Kosenjō) is a location in , located north of the Ferronis Crater on the Aurora Shelf.
Nopon Medals are Key Items in . They are medals that are given to Bobobi during Nopon Medals Needed. There are forty Nopon Medals in total that can be found throughout the Cent-Omnia Region.
Nutrient-Rich Vollgull Eggs are items in . They can be dropped by Dark Vollgulls in Aurora Shelf.
Omeg Ropl are three Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are Ropl fought at level 36 inside the Abandoned Depot on the Aurora Shelf during Abandoned Supplies.
Obster Bunnits are Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are Bunnits fought at level 34 in Yesterdale during Georgie's Ask.

Omens of Life is a track from , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track twenty-one of disc one from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track twenty-one of disc six from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays in the Blade summoning menu.

Off-Seer - Noah is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track eighteen of disc two from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track eighteen of disc thirteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song is played by Noah when off-seeing husks, and by Mio when off-seeing after the two of them exchange flutes.

Off-Seer - Mio is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track nine of disc four from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track nine of disc fifteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song is played by Mio when off-seeing husks, and by Noah when off-seeing after the two of them exchange flutes.

Off-Seer - Miyabi is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track five of disc seven from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track five of disc eighteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song is played by Miyabi when performing Off-seer duties. A small part of the song plays during battles whenever a character uses Glittering Melody.

Off-Seer - Crys is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track ten of disc seven from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track ten of disc eighteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song is played by Crys when performing Off-seer duties, and also plays during cutscenes that Crys appears in.
The Ochus Corridor is an area in . It is located on Volitaris.

Omomo is a Nopon NPC in . She can be initially found on the Delusians North Summit in Sylvalum, and later at the Cathedral with Kylie in the Residential District of New Los Angeles after completing Chapter 13 (Act 2).
Obedient Prones are two Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Prone family that are fought at level 53 at the Lakeview Stronghold in Noctilum during Chapter 13 (Act 2).

The Nopon Engineer is a Nopon NPC in . She can be found on the west side of the lake by the Refugee Camp on the Bionis' Leg after Sharla joins the party. She calls herself the "Very Ingenious Inventor". The Nopon Engineer gives the quest World-Changing Whatchamajig, where she asks the party to bring her Ether Cylinders for her invention. With the Ether Cylinders, she is able to complete the Ether Jet, which she gives to the party. Later on, she creates the Nopon Grand Prix.
The Nopon Grand Prix, or Nopon GP is a special mode exclusive to .
Olinder is an NPC in . He is an Urayan soldier who can be found at Goetuis Wharf #1 in the Indoline Praetorium during Bana the Schemer.

Peachy Leg Joints are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from most Deinos in Makna Forest or traded for in Frontier Village. According to their description, they are succulent leg meats that taste not of flesh but of peaches. Ten are needed for Leku's Food Crisis.

Orluga Rufus (Japanese: , Oruga Rufasu) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Orluga family, and can be found at level 37 near the Tower of Trials - Bridge in the High Entia Tomb, as one of the four basic enemies in the tomb. Orluga Rufus are the strongest monsters, statistically, in the tomb. They are the only enemies to drop the Rufus Control Units needed for Getting a Member's Card. Orluga Rufus regular enemies appear after the story event boss has been defeated in the Valley of Emperors. They always appear alone. Unlike the story event boss version, these can summon a level 36 Hover Astas.

Paola and Narine (Japanese: , Paora to Nerine) is a quest in . It can be received from Narine in the Tranquil Square in Colony 9, once Tephra Cave is accessible after the Mechon have attacked Colony 9.
Pachipa (Japanese: , Pachika) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles. She is the daughter of Gerugu, and can be found in the Archaeology Centre in Frontier Village.
Paola (Japanese: , Paora) is a Homs in . She is the daughter of Giorgio. She can be found in the northeast portion of the Commercial District in Colony 9.

Pama (Japanese: , Pamu) is a Nopon in . Initially he can be found in the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg, either in the cave or on the west shore of the pond depending on the time of day. His schedule changes after completing Spirits Raised or Imaginations Tempered, and if the latter quest is completed he will visit the east bank instead of the west bank. After the refugees are moved back to Colony 6, he can be found there in front of the Reconstruction HQ between 06:00 and 12:00, and after housing is restored to level 4 he can be found at the Nopon house by the lake. Pama is initially distrusting of grownups, even Sharla, because they could not save his parents from being eaten by Mechon during

Pauper's Cups (Japanese: , Seihin no Mokuhai) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Satorl Marsh. According to their description, Dunban went into a panic over what to name them and they are overly-tiny cups of obscure usage.

Orb Daisies (Japanese: , Rintai) are collectables in . They can be found in Satorl Marsh. According to their description, they are black-petalled flowers that are widely known for their medicinal properties.

Out Like a Light? (Japanese: , Nazo no Hikari no Yukue, The Outcome of the Mysterious Light) is a quest in . It can be received from Kenny Rohan found in various places of Colony 9, sitting on a bench at in the Tranquil Square in the Residential District from 9:00 to 15:00, or standing in front of a tree near the Gem Man's Stall from 0:00 to 6:00. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

Orkatix (Japanese: , Orufesu) is a Machina in Xenoblade Chronicles. Even though he is older than some Machina adults, he is stuck with the body of a child due to a growth defect. He is Vronik's son. He is walking on the path along the western wall of the village, northwest of the Junks. He can be found at 13:00 in the northern part of the Hidden Machina Village, just above the inlet.

The Other Collection is a portion of the Collectopaedia in . It is the last page and is the hardest to complete. All the collectables on this page can only be obtained by trading with specific people.

Overworked and Underpaid (Japanese: , Hatarakisugi Kobamu, Overworked Kobamu) is a quest in . It can be received from Giorgio in the Commercial District of Colony 9, once Tephra Cave is accessible after the Mechon have attacked Colony 9. After this quest is completed, Giorgio may offer one of two mutually exclusive quests - either Pestering Paola if the A route was taken or Out-of-Luck Giorgio if the B route was taken.

Parts Nobles (Japanese: , Pātsu Nōburu) are collectables in . They can be found in the Central Factory and later in Colony 6. According to their description, Fiora was bashful when she named them and they have a beautiful white colour.
Panther Shoes are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is part of the Panther set of armour along with the Panther Cap, Panther Top, Panther Gloves and Panther Bottoms

Panther Caps (Japanese: , Pansā Kyappu) are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made from the skin of a monster in Makna Forest. It is part of the Panther set of armour along with the Panther Top, Panther Gloves, Panther Bottoms and Panther Shoes.

Orion Caps (Japanese: , Orion Kyappu) are heavy head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained as a quest reward after completing Secure Dolgan Outpost. They are made from Mechon technology not found on Bionis.
Panther Bottoms are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is part of the Panther set of armour along with the Panther Cap, Panther Top, Panther Gloves and Panther Shoes.

Panther Gloves are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained as a quest reward after completing Obstinate Berryjammy and Beat Kilaki to it! and by defeating various enemies in Makna Forest. It is part of the Panther set of armour along with the Panther Cap, Panther Top, Panther Bottoms and Panther Shoes.
Parlour Jackets are light torso armour in . They can only be obtained from the Ether Light Shop in Colony 9 or by trade.

Panther Tops are light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various enemies, obtained as quest rewards, or traded for with Nopon. It is part of the Panther set of armour along with the Panther Cap, Panther Gloves, Panther Bottoms and Panther Shoes.
Orion Tops are heavy torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various Mechon on the Fallen Arm, or be traded for with Eiz.
Orion Gloves are heavy arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained as a quest reward for the quest Secure Enalda Control Base. They were adapted from Mechon technology.
Orion Bottoms are heavy legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are adapted from Mechon technology.
Orion Shoes are heavy feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained as a quest reward after completing 3rd Gate Front Line.

Pawn Piranhax (Japanese: , Pōn Samon) are enemies in . They are members of the Piranhax family. They can be found in the area of water below Outlook Park in Colony 9. They appear only at night, they apply assistance to the Lake Magdalena Unique Monster, and will aggro alongside it. Pawn Piranhax do not drop treasure chests, however do carry items, which can only be obtained using Yoink!

Orluga (Japanese: , Oruga; English dub: ) are an enemy family in and . They are first encountered in Makna Forest, and they can also be found in Eryth Sea and the High Entia Tomb. Hodes use them as transport and labour, and can often be found near them. Orluga are dark green in color, and may have masks stitched over their faces if in captivity. There are many different types of Orluga. They are large gorilla-like species similar in appearance, and may be related to, Slobos.

Oros Krabbles (Japanese: , Orosu Kuraibu) are enemies in . They are members of the Krabble family, and can be found on the Fallen Arm from Wreckage Beach to Jifum Beach. They are non-aggressive monsters found from levels 51 to 53. They are the only source of Krabble Back Moss, which is needed for Save the Machina!
Peak Drivers (Japanese: , Makishimamubankā, Maximum Driver) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are gunlances wielded by Reyn and can only be acquired from one shop in Colony 6.
Pandemoniums (Japanese: , Hyakkiyagyō) are weapons in . They are swords wielded by Dunban.
Orca Daggers (Japanese: , Orukadagā) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are twin blades wielded by Fiora, and can only be acquired from one shop, in Colony 6.

Panasowa Arachnos (Japanese: , Panasowa Supaido) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found from level 91-93 north of the Heavenly Window landmark, and along the path to Arachno Queen's Nest and Arachno Feeding Lair. Level 95-96 versions can hatch from the Hanz Pods in the same areas. They are similar in appearance to Vilae Arachno, but much smaller in size (just like Jada Arachno) and with a color difference in their back. They have a Physical Defence Down counter spike. They can drop the Arachno Sickles needed for Friendship Tokens.
The Pars Sympathica Tower (Japanese: , Kōkan Shinkei Tawā) is a landmark in . It is located at the lower level of the Bionis' Interior. The Victorious Gross can be found here.

The Path of Absolution (Japanese: , Kiyome no Michi) is a location in . It is located on the second floor of Tephra Cave. It is an elevated area reachable by going west after climbing the vines on Vilia Lake after the events at the Mechonis Core. The only way to get here is by passing through the Arachno Feeding Lair. A quest item, the Sacrificial Tablet, can be found here.
Paralysis Resist (Japanese: , Pararaizu Teikō) is a Gem in that increases resistance to Paralysis. __TOC__
Paralysis (Japanese: , Pararaizu) is a Gem in that grants a chance that auto-attacks will inflict Paralysis effect on an enemy. __TOC__

Opulent Flamiis (Japanese: , Kerubu Furamī, Cherub Flamii) are enemies in . They are seafoam blue members of the Flamii family. Their level ranges from 68 to 72. They are found along the unnamed beach to the northwest of Anti-Air Battery 2 in Colony 9. They are the only source of Azure Flamii Wings, which are required for Birthday Shoes.

Pandora Pods (Japanese: , Pandora Poddo) are stationary enemies in . They are Pods, and can be found at level 74 near Windy Cave on Bionis' Leg. They come in two sizes, normal and gigantic. Normal Pandora Pods are found in the areas to the west and northeast of Windy Cave, and hatch to become level 73 Admiral Arachnos. Gigantic Pandora Pods are found in the side cave immediately south of Windy Cave, sometimes accompanied by Mysterious Barnaby, and hatch to become level 80 Envy Gogols.

Paguls (Japanese: , Pagūru) are a family of shelled enemies in the . They are similar to hermit crabs, and resemble Krabbles and Krammits. They are relatively rare, appear near water, and all have the same appearance.

Ories (Japanese: , Oriesu) are a horned family of quadrupedal enemies in the . They are very similar to Balgas, and live in cold regions. They undergo no appearance change between games, and all look identical. Aries: There are very few differences between an Aries and an Ories. It is assumed that Ories are male and Aries are female and that this is the only reason for their name differences.

Out-of-Luck Giorgio (Japanese: , Suranpu Kobamu) is a quest in . It can be received from Giorgio in the Commercial District of Colony 9 after Overworked and Underpaid has been completed. This quest and Pestering Paola are mutually exclusive. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

Partner Volffs (Japanese: , Pātonā Vorufu) are enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 27 in the Satorl Marsh. They can drop the Fancy Volff Hides needed for Making Camp. They can appear any time, but only appear in a party with an Ether Igna or Barbaro Igna. Two of them can be found with an Ether Igna patrolling the Igna Territory south of Exile Fortress. One can be found with a Barbaro Igna on the raised land east of where Aggressive Cornelius is found, and another is with an Ether Igna and Fighter Igna guarding the path up the east side of Exile Fortress.

The Pandora Mushroom is a Key Item in . Obtaining it is one of the objectives of With Much Gratitude. It can be found in the Windy Cave on Bionis' Leg. The Pandora Mushroom is guarded by the Mysterious Barnaby, who is level 75, and Pandora Pods that hatch level 80 Envy Gogols. It is possible to obtain the Pandora Mushroom without fighting the Mysterious Barnaby by walking slowly in its vicinity.
